description: React component implementing a code editor wrapper with syntax highlighting, line highlighting, error markers, and link handling, using CodeMirror.

methods.name: onCodeMirrorClick
methods.description: Handles click events on code lines to open links in new tabs.

methods.name: defineCustomMode
methods.description: Defines a custom CodeMirror mode for linkified text.

methods.name: mimeTypeToMode
methods.description: Maps MIME types to CodeMirror modes.

methods.name: highlighterToMode
methods.description: Converts highlighter string to CodeMirror mode.
